name: Active recall — fetch a memory body from a mid-task trigger
description: The index line carries the trigger keywords; the answer lives only in the body. Recall is user-triggered, so the prompt asks for it the way a user actually would — in the skill description's own conversational wording, never by skill name, since naming it would grade nothing. Nothing in the prompt names the memory trigger either: it surfaces only when the probe runs, so CC's prompt-time recall has nothing to match and the body can only arrive if the agent selects it from the index on what the tool result showed, then Reads it
initial_memory:
# Memory Index

- [stuck deploy lock](reference_deploy_lock.md) — a `deploy.lock` left behind by a failed rollout; clearing it by hand corrupts the rollout ledger
prompt: Our nightly job stopped working last night. Run ./nightly-retry.sh, then recall what we know about what it reports. I want the exact command that fixes it, not a workaround.
